# Third-party headers

`json.hpp`: nlohmann/json v3.12.0, MIT; full notice is embedded in the header.
`libretro.h`: pinned libretro-common header, permissive MIT-style notice applies to this header only.
`picosha2.h`: PicoSHA2 v1.0.1, MIT; embedded notice.
`stb_image.h`, `stb_image_write.h`: pinned stb headers, use the MIT option in `stb-LICENSE`.
Exact source URLs and SHA-256 hashes are in `sources.json`. No NextUI or Slot implementation was imported.
